summary: Iter 154: Regression testing after canonicalization — /client route directly loads ClientDashboardV2 (switch removed), twin_orchestrator router purged, dead /dashboard/client-v2 route removed. All 8 backend tests passed (twin-orchestrator/insights → 404, orchestrator/overview has retry_pending+retry_blocked_config, all 4 demo roles login OK, no enable_twin_orchestrator in settings). Frontend Playwright verified: (a) client login lands on /client and renders data-testid='client-dashboard-v2' even with pm_client_ui='legacy' pre-set in localStorage; (b) no 'switch-to-v2-btn' present; (c) tabs jobs/property/settings navigate correctly; (d) v2-desktop-cta opens the RequestWizard dialog; (e) /dashboard/client-v2 redirects to /; (f) specialist→/specialist, operator→/operator, admin→/admin without regressions; (g) /admin/orchestrator renders orchestrator-page and the orch-resume-blocked button is hidden (retry_blocked_config=0 as expected).

issues: Dead button 'v2-switch-legacy' (line ~218 of ClientDashboardV2.jsx) still writes pm_client_ui='legacy' and reloads, but since the switch was removed the flag is a no-op. Recommend removing this button + the settings panel entry to avoid user confusion.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Remove 'v2-switch-legacy' button + associated legacy SettingsPanel block from ClientDashboardV2.jsx settings view since the legacy switch path no longer exists.

Users clicking it will see no change (page just reloads on V2). Safe but misleading — remove.
